# KH Rentals coding instructions

Follow the [project engineering rules](../PROJECT_RULES.md) for repository changes.

## R5 assignments

Start with the [R5 engineering instructions](../docs/R5-SELF-HANDOFF-20261115.md#engineering-instructions) and the current assignment in that handoff. The execution plan sets release scope. The acceptance ledger records which outcomes have evidence. Dated checkpoints describe earlier work.

## Multi-tenant migration assignments

For an assigned migration sprint, use the [sprint index](../docs/sprints/README.md), [migration progress tracker](../docs/sprints/progress-tracker.md) and [migration overview](../docs/multi-tenant-sprint-plan.md). These documents govern migration sprint work only.

## Azure work
